metadata.chunk_title: Credit Hour Requirements + Required GPA

facts.value: Students must earn a minimum of 24 credits during the yearly fall/spring review period.

metadata.chunk_title: Credit Hour Requirements + Required GPA

facts.value: Students may not use summer sessions and consortium agreement classes, repeated classes, incomplete grades or audited classes to meet the minimum 24 credit hours requirement.

metadata.chunk_title: Credit Hour Requirements + Required GPA

facts.value: Any credits received by examination, including AP, CLEP, IB and other tests, do not count towards the minimum 24 credit hours requirement.
